title: Why Cutting Winners Too Early Destroys Your Edge
description:
🔗 TRY OPTIONSPLAY FREE Start your 14-day free trial: https://new.optionsplay.com/registration

Risk management is not only about cutting losses -- it is also about giving the right winners room to matter. Tony Zhang shows how to build a winner management plan using partial exits, alerts, trailing levels, and rolling strategies.

What You'll Learn:
  •  When a trade has earned more room versus when to take profits
  •  How partial exits help balance locking in gains and staying in the trade
  •  How to set alerts and trailing levels that protect without cutting too early
  •  When rolling a position makes sense as a winner management strategy
  •  How to use OptionsPlay tools to apply these principles in real trades

What's covered:
00:00 - Welcome & Series Recap: Why Winning Trades Aren't Enough
03:21 - The Hardest Trade to Make (And Why You Must Learn It)

12:16 - Cut Losers Fast — Reserve Mental Capital for Your Winners
13:43 - The Numbers: 56% Win Rate & the 68% Edge on Adds

28:49 - Live Trade Walkthrough: Broadcom (AVGO) — A Loser
31:36 - The Real Numbers: Winners Outpay Losers 4 to 1
43:08 - How to Size Each Add: Fixed vs. Exponential Method
45:54 - Homework, Recap & What's Coming Next Week
